about: OpenFlowLM's models on the same machine and prompts, for comparison: a FastFlowLM fork that runs them on its own open (IRON / mlir-aie) NPU kernels. comparable_quants: the GGUF quants of the same model whose Artlite rows the charts pair with this one, first match first (q4nx is Q4_1 numerics, with Q8_0 tiles where a row's weights say so). A row's version: an older build, where the file's gives wrong output. A note on a missing value says why it is missing.
version: 0.1.0-9b1409d (Atomic-Germ/OpenFlowLM-Next at 9b1409d), oflm serve with every model on the open kernels, default prefill chunks of 4096, each model at its native context (Qwen3.8 27B at 131072: its KV at the native 262144 does not fit beside the weights with 16 GB to spare)
machine: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo, XDNA 2 NPU), NPU power mode turbo
chart_note: oflm serve on its open kernels, 4096-token prefill chunks, runs of at most 5 minutes

method.ttft_s: streaming /v1/chat/completions with a Paul Graham essays prompt of n tokens, greedy, 128 tokens: client time to the first token (median of up to 3)
method.decode_tps: (tokens - 1) / time from the first to the last streamed token
method.engine_prefill_tps: OpenFlowLM's own figures: without the HTTP and streaming overhead
method.engine_decode_tps: OpenFlowLM's own figures: without sampling and streaming
